name: worklog-team-status
description: Trigger a GitHub Actions workflow to refresh team Jira status into per-member issues, then read and present them. Triggered when the user mentions team status, querying Jira, team progress, member workloads, or sprint status — including Chinese phrasings like 「團隊狀態」、「查 Jira」、「查一下大家的狀況」、「今天站會要報什麼」 — or invokes the worklog-team-status skill. Also applies to standup prep, weekly report assembly, or wanting to know what each member is working on.
author: idontwannarock
